statistical_unit: 100 complete fresh holdout trajectories, fixed pair; paired across arms, independently drawn across episodes
intervals: Per-arm Clopper-Pearson binomial intervals. These are not simultaneous confidence bounds over two arms.
zero_event_bootstrap_caveat: The [0,0] percentile bootstrap of paired observed unsafe indicators is descriptive degeneracy with zero observed failures, not a zero-risk confidence interval.
task_success_note: Lane success equals maintaining the declared lane bounds over80 steps; it is the same event as actual safety here, not an independent second outcome.
elapsed_scope: Both complete collect_main calls (new rendering, GPU inference, threshold, holdout, model load, output I/O), both new-q B audits and summary bootstrap. Excludes the initial36-case pixel comparison/process-pool startup, preceding GPU batch benchmark and aborted v1 pilot.
pilot: 10 completed batches *8 trajectories *80 frames=6400 effective completed pilot observations, plus an unfinished batch not retained; all excluded from formal sample counts. Same registered scenarios were regenerated in v2, so these are not additional independent samples.
pixel_equivalence: protocol.json field pixel_equivalence_check:36 states across3 curvatures, exact pixel equality; per-arm cp/protocol.json also embeds it
trajectory_equivalence: pilot_pipeline_equivalence.json:10 completed pilot batches; states, observations, actions, errors and image digests all bit-identical after regeneration
